Subject: Alder MAP v5 — final decisions needed for signoff + start date

Team,

Sharing the updated Mutual Action Plan (Alder_MAP_v5.pdf attached) after yesterday's exec call. Alder is ready to close provided we nail a few coordination items this week. High-level asks from Alder and the hooks we need to confirm on our side: 

- Final approval gate: Legal (Kim) + Procurement PO receipt + Revenue exec nod for the promotional credit.
- Signature window: Alder prefers an e-sign window next Tue–Thu (May 22–24) local time.
- Start date: target customer day-one is Mon May 29 (preferred), they want a confirmed capacity reservation for the first 72 hours.
- SLA tweaks: they asked for a 99.9% latency SLO during peak hours. Ops wants to confirm canary fallback if capacity tightens.

Attachments: Alder_MAP_v5.pdf (MAP), SLA_summary.xlsx (SLA redline), pricing_term_sheet_v3.pdf (final commercial).

My ask: Kim — can you confirm legal's redlines by EOD Mon (5/20)? Monica — can procurement confirm how quickly they can accept a PO and whether Alder can e-sign then send PO? Logan — Ops: can you confirm capacity reservation for May 29 (dedicated pool pin) and the fallback that preserves their latency SLO?

If we can confirm those, I'll schedule the DocuSign packet for Tue morning (5/22) and put together the comms for kickoff.

Thanks,
Rafael
Sales, Redwood Inference

Rafael,

Thanks for the update — Alder is aligned on the timeline but two quick clarifications before we commit to the e-sign window: 

1) Capacity reservation: we need written confirmation that the dedicated pool will support the initial expected QPS for the first 72 hours (we'll share the forecast in an excel). Any auto-scaling that could affect per-token latency needs explicit mention.
2) Signature timing: procurement prefers DocuSign between 9–11am PT on Tue (5/22) so our procurement approver can be on the line. If that slips, we may need to push start date a week.

We can get the PO out same day as signature if legal signoffs are in place. Also — is there a short checklist we can use to confirm the final go/no-go? A one-page checklist would be great for our execs.

Sam Green

Subject: Re: Alder MAP v5 — final decisions needed for signoff + start date

Sam — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers and next steps below.

1) Capacity reservation / latency SLO: Logan confirmed we can pin a dedicated pool for Alder's Day 0–2 (72 hours). We will allocate the requested GPUs and hold burst credits for the first 72 hours. Ops will document the canary fallback to a quantized model variant if we hit sustained saturation; that fallback preserves throughput but may add up to 60–100ms tail latency during extreme peaks. Logan — please add the documented fallback to SLA_summary.xlsx and mark the paragraph we will show Alder.

2) Signature timing & DocuSign: Rafael — I can approve the legal redlines by EOD Mon (5/21). Once approved, I will trigger the DocuSign packet. Proposed DocuSign slot: Tue May 22, 09:00–10:30 PT (procurement-friendly). We will include an exec-approval checkbox for the promotional credit so the packet is signable by both legal and the exec sponsor. Link (placeholder): https://docusign.com/placeholder/ALD-219

3) Go/no-go checklist (one-pager): I drafted a short checklist in the MAP folder — I'll attach a PDF to the packet, but here are the items we will require: 
   - Legal redline acceptance (Redwood)
   - PO received (Alder) OR payment method confirmed
   - Dedicated pool reservation confirmed (Redwood Ops)
   - SLA SLO and fallback documented and accepted
   - Kickoff owner and first-week runbook assigned

If Alder agrees to the Tue e-sign slot, we will aim to finalize before 11am PT and confirm the May 29 start date. If we miss Tue, we will propose Wednesday as a backup but Alder indicated that would be risky for their internal calendar.

Monica — can you confirm procurement sequencing (PO after e-sign vs PO pre-sign) so we can set expectations in the DocuSign message?

Sam — happy to hop on a 15-min align call Tue 8:30 PT if you want to run through the checklist before DocuSign.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
